Data issues found and fixed: (1) ' Adelie' and 'Chinstarp' labels were normalized to 'Adelie' and 'Chinstrap'; (2) 3 rows with negative flipper lengths (below minimum 170 mm) were excluded; (3) 1 duplicate row was removed. The 'sex' column had 1 missing value, but it was left as is per rules (do not guess). All fixes were approved.
